description: Returns a link to the North Cyprus car booking page with the dates filled in. The person picks a car and confirms there. No credit card or deposit is needed.

currency.description: Currency the booking page opens in.

language.description: Language of the result and the booking link: 'tr' for Turkish, otherwise 'en'.

pickup_at.description: Pickup date-time 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm', Cyprus local time, within the booking hours.

return_at.description: Return date-time 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm', after pickup_at, within the booking hours.

name: get_booking_link
title: Get a booking link
